Definition
[Width] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0072 1. ch28:28.37–28.38\group Finite Width

For a proper smooth $F$ on an orientable surface, $w(F,g)=\sup _c\mathcal H^1(F^{-1}(c))$, and $w(g)=\inf _F w(F,g)$.
